title: Isabela vice mayor tests negative for drugs, apologizes for outburst
summary: Harold Respicio, vice mayor of Reina Mercedes in Isabela, said Wednesday that he tested negative in a qualitative urine drug test that Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla had challenged him to take.
